prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in, reorder changes as there is only 1 test so far.
Evidence is still thin for home, new_flow changes as there is only 1 test so far.
Evidence is still thin for adoption, copy changes as there is only 1 test so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish, notification changes as there is only 1 test so far.
Predictions were consistently too high across all initial tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, copy: -0.7% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, notification: +0.1% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, new_flow: +1.4% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: -7.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] choose_path_split_hero_redesign: Redesign the path selection screen with a split hero layout clearly comparing pre-made pets versus custom created pets side by side. (why: choose_path conversion is 76.2% with a long mean duration of 514s, indicating that users hesitate over which path to choose.)
1: [finish, new_screen] desktop_pet_placement_guide: Add a new post-onboarding screen explaining how the pet sits on the desktop screen and where to find system tray controls. (why: Multiple support emails mention pets missing from the desktop and confusion on how to control or hide the desktop pet.)
2: [sign_in, reorder] reorder_sign_in_after_pick_friend: Move sign-in to immediately after selecting a pet in pick_friend so users bind account creation to their chosen companion. (why: Eight support tickets report lost or reset pets after re-authenticating; moving sign-in right after pet choice ensures early account binding.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] preset_pet_quick_adoption_flow: Introduce a fast-track confirmation screen for users selecting pre-made pets to bypass heavy photo setup. (why: The adoption step drops to 60.9% conversion with an 89s median time; standard pet selection needs an expedited route.)
4: [home, wait_info] generation_progress_breakdown_waiting: Display explicit status stage descriptions and estimated timing on the waiting screen while background pet generation completes. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading to drop-off while waiting for pet assets to render.)
5: [adoption, copy] adoption_certificate_clarity_copy: Update the adoption certificate copy to clarify that pet naming can be edited later and setup is almost complete. (why: Users stall on adoption certificate (60.9% conversion, median 89s), likely overthinking pet names or settings.)
6: [home, notification] background_generation_desktop_notify: Turn on system notification triggers on the waiting screen so users are notified when pet preparation finishes. (why: Mean waiting duration is over 38 minutes (2336s), showing users switch to other desktop windows and lose track of onboarding.)
7: [sign_in, incentive] account_cloud_sync_sign_in_hint: Add cloud backup assurance text and a highlight badge on the sign-in screen. (why: Support logs 8 complaints regarding missing or reset pets on sign-in; explicit sync assurance reduces sign-in hesitation.)
8: [finish, layout] home_intro_stage_layout: Switch the home intro screen layout to stage focus mode to give the newly generated pet maximum visibility. (why: Finish conversion drops to 64.8% with 395s median time; presenting a focused visual stage boosts completion momentum.)
